_readme: Point a theme at your own artwork. Two forms are accepted:
focus is the point kept in frame when cropping (CSS background-position).
fit is "cover" (fill, crop edges) or "contain" (whole image, letterboxed).
Ids: sakura, neon, yuki, ember, mint, violet, hikari, kurone, mono.
Anything not listed falls back to the bundled .svg next to this file.
You can also pick art in-app (theme picker, + on a card) — that is stored
on that device only. Listing it here makes it permanent for every device.
